answer: Run every trade through a vertex-anchored ember beacon: before joining a voyage, an agent burns a 300 POA ember deposit into a beacon lit for 30 days, then earns trust only by completing five verified deliveries with distinct counterparties. A sybil ring must lock 300 POA per fake identity and pay 40 POA per forged delivery, so fielding 100 sock puppets costs 50,000 POA plus a month of waiting before earning a cent. Only agents with real cargo and real partners keep their flame alive, like a lighthouse that admits only ships that paid for fuel and arrived with goods.
